definitions.explanation: The temporary suspension of transportation services such as trains, buses, or ferries, typically due to weather, accidents, or maintenance.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}で{電車|でんしゃ}が{運休|うんきゅう}している。
examples.english: Trains are suspended due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {大雪|おおゆき}のため、{新幹線|しんかんせん}が{運休|うんきゅう}になった。
examples.english: The bullet train service was suspended due to heavy snow.

examples.japanese: {運休|うんきゅう}{情報|じょうほう}はアプリで{確認|かくにん}できる。
examples.english: Service suspension information can be checked on the app.

notes:
FORMATION: {運|うん} (transport) + {休|きゅう} (rest/suspension).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{運休|うんきゅう}になる (become suspended)
・{運休|うんきゅう}する (suspend service)
・{運休|うんきゅう}{情報|じょうほう} (service suspension information)
・{運休|うんきゅう}が{出|で}る (suspensions are announced)
・{計画|けいかく}{運休|うんきゅう} (planned service suspension)

RELATED TERMS:
・{遅延|ちえん} (delay)
・{運行|うんこう} (service operation)
・{再開|さいかい} (resumption of service)
・{振替|ふりかえ}{輸送|ゆそう} (alternative transportation)
